name: Tapan Vahal
bio: Tapan Vahal is a Legal Manager and Senior Lawyer at Tax Planning, bringing 9 years of legal experience across UAE personal legal matters, including wills, powers of attorney, and estate planning for individuals and families. He works closely with clients to simplify complex legal matters and guide them through each step with clarity and care. He reviews all content published by Tax Planning to ensure it is accurate, practical, and aligned with current UAE laws.

bio: Aramide Shuaib is a Content Writer at Tax Planning who works closely with the firm's legal specialists to simplify complex legal topics into accurate and practical guidance for individuals, families, and businesses across the UAE.
